🚨 **New Class Update Is Live!**
⚔️ **New Class: Sword Master**
Master the art of the sword, unleash powerful attacks, and dominate the battlefield as the legendary Swordmaster!

❤️ **Expedition Mode Improvement**
You can now use items to increase your maximum HP in Expedition Mode!
Jump into the game and try the new update now! Thank you for your patience and support! 🔥

🔥 DEFEND THE BASE! 🔥

Monsters are invading the military base! Fight together with other players, protect the base, and stop the invasion.

⚔️ Fight waves of monsters
🔫 Unlock powerful guns and melee weapons
🧠 Choose unique classes with special skills
🎖️ Complete daily missions to earn Medals
📦 Collect airdrops for extra rewards
🪖 Recruit soldiers to fight by your side
💰 Earn Cash, upgrade, and become stronger!

The longer you survive, the stronger the monsters become. Defend the base, upgrade your loadout, and hold the line!

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!
